extracted.name: 🍯 Honey Lemon Chicken 😋
extracted.description: Very easy and kids like it
ingredient_lines: pcs Chicken Breast, cleaned and cut to
2 tbsp All purpose flour + 1 tbsp cornflour
1 cup water + 1 tbsp cornstarch, mix well
instruction_lines: Clean and cut chicken Marinate for 15 mins
Coat marinated chicken with flour mixture, and fry until golden brown, set aside.
In a pan, sautè garlic with butter, until it turn brown, add honey and lemon juice
Add fried chicken to honey mixture, add 1 cup water with 1 tbsp cornstarch, cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked.
